title: Release Directories and Blue-Green Environments
objective: Compare atomic-release and environment-switching deployment patterns.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Capistrano-style deployment creates immutable release directories, prepares dependencies, then atomically moves a current symlink. Retained releases give rollback targets.
Blue-green deployment prepares a complete inactive environment, verifies it, switches traffic, and retains the old environment for rollback. Database compatibility must span the switch.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Compare atomic-release and environment-switching deployment patterns.
